## Proposed title

docs: add InkBloom MaxPack — brush build brief

## Summary

Adds the technical brush build brief for the InkBloom MaxPack (60 brushes), plus placeholders for asset files and a release draft. This branch provides author-facing documentation and an asset manifest to prepare the final .brushset export.

## What to review

- docs/InkBloom-MaxPack.md — brush build specifications
- assets/inkbloom/README.md — expected asset filenames and sizes
- releases/InkBloom-MaxPack-ReleaseDraft.md — suggested release notes

## Checklist

- [ ] Confirm the brush brief covers all brush families and per-brush settings
- [ ] Upload the real PNG assets to `assets/inkbloom/` (grains/shapes/canvas textures)
- [ ] Test brushes on iPad Mini and iPad Pro (scale verification)
- [ ] Add final `InkBloom-MaxPack.brushset` and `InkBloom-MaxPack-Full.zip` to the release or a release asset storage

## Notes

If you want, I can:
- Add the PNG asset files (if you upload them here or provide URLs)
- Create a draft GitHub release and attach the exported files after you provide them
- Open the pull request from this branch to `main` and add reviewers
